Definition: from the same as G730; properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed):--praise, virtue.
BiblicalUsage: The word means excellence, virtue, the manliness of a life well lived. Paul says think on whatever is true and lovely, if there be any virtue and any praise, and Peter says the church is to show forth the praises, the excellencies, of Him who called us out of darkness.
TheologicalSignificance: Virtue is not a private achievement, it is the excellence of God shown forth by His people.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
